samples.evidence: Intel driver updater: explicit quiet relaunch and runas elevation; verifies Microsoft hardware publisher signatures before pnputil installation. Hash checks can be skipped when no expected hash is available; no exploit or hostile deployment identified.

Business intelligence deployment package with Inno Setup compression libraries and Saturn image/reflection code. Ordinary x86 calls do not demonstrate a decoder; image/reflection co-occurrence does not demonstrate steganography.
Cloud management module and AWS SSM administration documents. Host-query commands are administrative capabilities, not C2 tasking.

SharePoint provisioning and rule runner. Hidden launcher starts shell.ps1 -SysTray. Base64 password decoding is in DPAPI credential retrieval thousands of lines away from the launcher and expression evaluation.

General .NET helper library; build targets add an opt-in FastCall module initializer. CLR patching and process termination helpers are unusual functionality, without attacker deployment or targeting evidence.
Dynamics/Power Platform administration module and Microsoft SDK dependencies; property description indexing is generic data access.
Mobile driver license ISO reader SDK with smartcard/Bluetooth libraries and protected managed assemblies. HTTP and Base64 APIs alongside reflection do not establish network payload loading.

Chocolatey library embeds package-management helper executables including shimgen and 7-Zip. Policy bypass/runas text, BinaryFormatter, reflection, resources, and temp execution APIs do not independently establish malicious intent or a linked loader chain.
Good Grief CLI and console/runtime dependencies; --path help and the word reflective do not indicate ransomware or a RAT.
Carbon game-server mod SDK/common/profiler/test assemblies; no suspicious or hostile rule findings initially or after review.
